title: Volve field Daily Drilling Report DDR-TEST-00150 — wellbore not published in this release
source_system: Equinor Volve / public DDR release — Volve field Daily Drilling
excerpt:
00:00 - 04:30: Waited on weather for pulling production risers meanwhile lifted equipment from well f-4 and f-5 from WH deck to drill floor centralizers, boat collision stool etc. cleaned pits and shakers
04:30 - 07:00: Waited on weather for skidding cantilever and pulling production risers too strong wind to skid. Meanwhile installed moonpool hatch. Removed scaffolding and handrail on WH deck. Cleaned pits and shakers
07:00 - 19:00: Waited on weather for skidding cantilever and pulling production risers. Too strong wind to skid meanwhile cleaned trip tanks assisted removal of pit sensors cleaned shakers opened BOP and inspected cavities opened annular preventer and inspected same
19:00 - 00:00: Waited on weather for skidding cantilever and pulling production risers. Too strong wind to skid meanwihle continued cleaning shakers continued inspecting BOP and ram cavities open and inspected dry bulk silos
